statement: When adding a refusal that stops false claims, add a positive fixture for the most common real shape too. A refusal list that is too wide switches the detector off without anyone noticing. Cejel's CI-lockfile detector, after the second review of #521, refused any step in which a word from CONDITIONAL_SHELL_WORDS appeared anywhere, and the list included `test`. So a step running `npm ci` and then `npm test`, and `cargo test --locked`, were never claimed (src/witan/repo-signals.ts, findLockfileRequirement at 7db216363). Every positive fixture had a single-command step, so nothing failed. A third review found it. Fix: read conditional words only in command position, and add positive fixtures with multi-command steps, cargo test --locked and CRLF line endings.
